newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin bags ducks despite heart trouble-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin bags ducks despite heart trouble-Interfax.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has shot more than 40 ducks and a hefty wild boar during hunting trips near the official residence where he is preparing to undergo heart surgery, Interfax news agency said on Sunday.

"Over a few hours last week, the president shot more than 40 ducks and also downed an adult boar weighing more than 200 kilos (440 lbs) with the first shot," the agency said, quoting a source close to the president.
Yeltsin shared his shooting successes with visiting German Chancellor Helmut Kohl at dinner on Saturday, Interfax added, quoting sources in presidential circles.
They said the dinner at the Rus residence, 95 km (60 miles) north west of Moscow, was based on the fruits of Yeltsin's hunting trips.

Kohl, whose one-day visit was planned before Yeltsin announced on Thursday that he was to have heart surgery, said after their meeting that the Kremlin leader was optimistic about the operation, which he is due to undergo later this month.
